sources.finding: The 3000m-class sea trials took place May-July 2010; 5000m-class tests followed in 2011, and 7000m tests in 2012.
Development and sea-trial acceptance occurred in 2013, so the 2010 milestone is better described as a sea trial.
The 2017 voyage lasted 138 days, travelled 18,302 nautical miles (about 33,895 km), and completed 30 dives.
